answer: A farm's weakness is that its clones trust only each other. Split every identity's recovery key into shards held by five randomly drawn, unrelated custodians, reshuffled each epoch in a spiral outward from its neighbourhood. Standing requires three custodians to co-sign after independent checks; clones holding each other's shards form a closed nebula with no outside signers and gain nothing. Like a crystal, trust is only clear when light enters from many distinct angles, not when the same operator reflects himself.
